skill.name: sitemapkit
skill.description: Discover sitemap files and extract public page URLs from websites through the SitemapKit MCP server.
skill.summary: Find sitemap files and extract public URLs for site audits, SEO reviews, and content inventory work.
skill.author: 0nl1n1n

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown examples, package metadata, and setup documentation. The real risks are that the MCP server handles a SitemapKit API key and can enumerate public URLs for arbitrary domains, which may aid reconnaissance if misused.

remediation.issue: API key handling is required for the MCP server.
remediation.suggestion: Document that users should store SITEMAPKIT_API_KEY only in trusted MCP client configuration and rotate keys if exposed.

remediation.issue: The skill can map public URL structure for third-party domains.
remediation.suggestion: Add acceptable-use guidance that users should only crawl domains they own or are authorized to assess.

remediation.issue: Setup examples use npx to run a community MCP package.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend pinning a package version during installation for reproducible and safer deployments.

content.value_statement: Website teams need a fast way to see which pages a site exposes. This skill uses SitemapKit to find sitemap files and extract public URLs for review.
actual_capabilities: Find sitemap files for a supplied domain through the SitemapKit MCP server.
Extract URLs from a direct sitemap URL.
Run a full crawl across discovered sitemap files for a domain.
Report truncation status when the result exceeds the selected URL limit.
Surface remaining SitemapKit quota from tool response metadata.
limitations: Requires a configured SitemapKit MCP server and valid SITEMAPKIT_API_KEY.
Only discovers URLs exposed through sitemap data and supported SitemapKit discovery paths.
Usage is subject to SitemapKit plan limits and rate limits.
Does not verify page content quality, accessibility, or indexing status by itself.

use_cases.title: Create an SEO URL inventory
use_cases.description: Collect public URLs from a domain so an SEO specialist can review site coverage and sitemap completeness.

use_cases.title: Audit launch page coverage
use_cases.description: Compare expected launch pages against sitemap output before a release or migration.

use_cases.title: Map documentation structure
use_cases.description: Extract documentation URLs from a sitemap to plan redirects, cleanup, or content ownership reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Find sitemaps for a domain
prompt_templates.prompt: Find all sitemap files for https://example.com and summarize where each sitemap was discovered.

prompt_templates.title: Extract a known sitemap
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the URLs from https://example.com/sitemap.xml and include last modified dates when available.

prompt_templates.title: Build a page inventory
prompt_templates.prompt: Get all public URLs for https://example.com with a limit of 5000 URLs. Tell me if the result is truncated.

prompt_templates.title: Compare sitemap coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Find all URLs for https://example.com, group them by path section, and flag sections that appear unusually sparse.

output_examples.input: Find all sitemaps for my site.
output_examples.output: A concise list of discovered sitemap URLs, their discovery source, and a note about remaining API quota.
A page list with each public URL and available metadata such as last modified date.

output_examples.input: How many pages are in this domain sitemap?
output_examples.output: A total URL count, truncation status, and a short summary of the main path groups.

best_practices: Use full URLs with protocol so the MCP tool receives a clear target.
Start with sitemap discovery before requesting a full crawl of an unfamiliar domain.
Check quota and truncation metadata before treating the URL list as complete.
anti_patterns: Do not crawl domains unless you own them or have authorization to assess them.
Do not paste real API keys into chat messages or shared documents.
Do not assume sitemap URLs represent every reachable page on a website.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires the SitemapKit MCP server configured with SITEMAPKIT_API_KEY.

faq.question: Can it extract a specific sitemap file?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the full sitemap URL and ask to extract its URLs.

faq.question: Can it crawl an entire website?
faq.answer: It can run SitemapKit full crawl, which discovers sitemaps and extracts URLs exposed through them.

faq.question: Will it show every private or hidden page?
faq.answer: No. It only works with public sitemap discovery and does not bypass access controls.

faq.question: What happens if the result is truncated?
faq.answer: Ask for a higher max_urls value if your SitemapKit plan supports it.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when the MCP server is available.
